product.title: Sunset 4-Hour Grand Teton Wildlife Adventure

description.text: Grand Teton National Park offers some of America's most spectacular wildlife, including grizzlies, wolves, elk, moose, bison, antelope, bighorn sheep, and bald eagles. Beat the crowds and enjoy 360-degree viewing on this small-group tour with a naturalist wildlife guide in a custom vehicle with a roof hatch and a window for everyone. Stops include Grand Teton National Park. Swarovski scopes and binoculars ensure great visibility, with iPads to help you learn more about what you're viewing.Watch Grand Teton's wildlife at sunset, when animals are most active Just seven travelers on board—with a window seat for everyone Professional gra Ideal for travelers basing in Jackson Hole who want a guided Wyoming outing without self-driving mountain roads.
